versions.changelog:
- Added guidance on using the command-scoped `--config <path>` option to select a config file for a single invocation.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

- Added TXT file support in the list of supported formats in the description.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

Initial release of poink-semantic-search.

- Enables building and querying local document knowledge bases using semantic and hybrid search.
- Supports PDF, Markdown, DOCX, ODT, and FODT file formats.
- Integrates with the poink CLI for search, ingestion, organization, and inspection tasks.
- Offers JSON and text output options for CLI commands.
